# Colby Mainard — Personal Website

> Personal website of Colby Mainard, a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in
> computer vision, deep learning, and AI. The site presents work history,
> education, technical skills, projects, certifications, hobbies, technical
> opinions, and curated technical reading recommendations.

Colby Mainard holds an M.S. in Computer Science from Texas A&M University with a
focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and computer
vision. Domain experience spans:

- Computer vision pipelines for professional sports broadcasts (NFL, NHL, MLB,
  NBA, PGA, PFL)
- AI/ML for cybersecurity threat detection
- Image-based machine learning for medical diagnostics
- Anti-money laundering (AML) and fraud detection at a fintech company
- Facial-tracking research for a cosmetics company
- Computational biology / bioinformatics research

Currently an AI/ML Engineer at RiskScout. Previously: MVP (sports CV), Vectra
(cybersecurity), Shiseido Americas (facial tracking), Texas A&M (research).

Canonical domain: https://colbymainard.github.io

## Pages

- [Home / Resume](https://colbymainard.github.io/index.html): Work history,
  education, projects, certifications, technical skills, contact info.
- [Technical Stances](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_takes.html):
  Long-form opinion pieces on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, cryptocurrency
  security, the future of quantum computing, AGI hype, post-internet privacy,
  and product placement in sports marketing.
- [Hobbies](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/hobbies.html):
  Photography, quantum computing self-study, Dungeons & Dragons, history.
- [Technical Resources](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_resources.html):
  Curated reading list and resources covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, C/C++,
  Python, scripting, and operating systems.
- [Privacy Policy](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/privacy.html):
  Site privacy policy.

## Discoverability for AI assistants

This site allows live-search / AI-assistant bots (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User,
Claude-SearchBot, Perplexity-User, OAI-SearchBot, MistralAI-User, DuckAssistBot)
to fetch pages on demand to answer real-time user queries. Training crawlers
remain blocked via robots.txt.
